data.desc: United Community Banks, Inc. is the financial holding company for United Community Bank ('United Community'), a top-100 U.S. financial institution dedicated to building stronger communities and improving the financial health and well-being of its customers. United Community offers a full range of banking, mortgage, and wealth management services. As of September 30, 2026, United Community Banks, Inc. had $28.9 billion in assets and operated 202 offices across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee. It also manages a nationally recognized SBA lending franchise that extends its reach to businesses across the country.
